<?php
require '/wordpress/wp-load.php';
$options = [
 'woocommerce_default_country'=>'TW','woocommerce_currency'=>'TWD','woocommerce_price_num_decimals'=>'0',
 'woocommerce_allowed_countries'=>'specific','woocommerce_specific_allowed_countries'=>['TW'],
 'woocommerce_enable_guest_checkout'=>'no','woocommerce_enable_myaccount_registration'=>'yes',
 'woocommerce_registration_generate_password'=>'no','woocommerce_enable_signup_and_login_from_checkout'=>'yes',
 'woocommerce_enable_checkout_login_reminder'=>'yes','woocommerce_registration_generate_username'=>'yes',
 'wooecpay_enabled_payment'=>'yes','wooecpay_enabled_payment_stage'=>'yes',
 'woocommerce_Wooecpay_Gateway_Credit_settings'=>['enabled'=>'yes','description'=>'綠界信用卡測試付款'],
 'blogdescription'=>'燒肉與餐桌選物','timezone_string'=>'Asia/Taipei',
];
foreach($options as $key=>$value) update_option($key,$value);
WC_Install::create_pages();
foreach (['cart'=>['購物車','[woocommerce_cart]'],'checkout'=>['結帳','[woocommerce_checkout]'],'myaccount'=>['會員中心','[woocommerce_my_account]']] as $key=>$page) {
 wp_update_post(['ID'=>wc_get_page_id($key),'post_title'=>$page[0],'post_content'=>$page[1]]);
}
$zone = new WC_Shipping_Zone(); $zone->set_zone_name('台灣宅配'); $zone->add_location('TW','country'); $zone->save();
$id=$zone->add_shipping_method('flat_rate');
update_option('woocommerce_flat_rate_'.$id.'_settings',['title'=>'宅配','cost'=>'80','tax_status'=>'none']);
require_once ABSPATH.'wp-admin/includes/media.php';
require_once ABSPATH.'wp-admin/includes/file.php';
require_once ABSPATH.'wp-admin/includes/image.php';

update_option('blogname','炭市肉舖');
update_option('woocommerce_coming_soon','no');
update_option('woocommerce_demo_store','yes');
update_option('woocommerce_demo_store_notice','完整測試商店｜僅供試購，請使用虛構的顧客及配送資料。');
update_option('woocommerce_cod_settings',['enabled'=>'yes','title'=>'模擬下單（不收款）','description'=>'測試建立訂單與庫存，可在會員中心查看訂單。']);
foreach ([
 [14,'厚切牛排','牛排','steak',580,'250 公克／包'],
 [16,'雙人燒肉組','燒肉組合','cuts',880,'500 公克／盒'],
 [18,'牛肉漢堡排','快速料理','burger',320,'150 公克 × 2 片']
] as [$id,$name,$cat,$image,$price,$unit]){
 $p=new WC_Product_Simple(); $p->set_status('publish'); $p->set_manage_stock(true); $p->set_stock_quantity(30); $p->set_name($name); $p->set_slug('market-'.$id); $p->set_short_description($unit.'。冷凍配送，圖片為料理情境示意。'); $p->set_regular_price($price);
 $term=term_exists($cat,'product_cat') ?: wp_insert_term($cat,'product_cat');
 $p->set_category_ids([(int)$term['term_id']]); $src=get_theme_file_path('assets/'.$image.'.jpg'); $tmp=wp_tempnam();copy($src,$tmp);
 $media=media_handle_sideload(['name'=>$image.'.jpg','tmp_name'=>$tmp],0,$name); if(is_wp_error($media)) throw new Exception($media->get_error_message());
 $p->set_image_id($media); $p->save();
}

wp_update_custom_css_post('body .woocommerce-store-notice { position:static!important; z-index:auto!important; } .home .mast { top:0!important; }');

update_option('woocommerce_demo_store','no');
file_put_contents(get_stylesheet_directory().'/footer.php', str_replace('<footer class="site-footer">','<footer class="site-footer"><small>沙盒測試｜請使用虛構資料，不收款。</small>', file_get_contents(get_stylesheet_directory().'/footer.php')));
wp_mkdir_p(WPMU_PLUGIN_DIR);

<?php
// Keep the Playground operator session separate from storefront testing.
add_filter('show_admin_bar','__return_false');
add_filter('determine_current_user',function($id){
 if(!$id || is_admin()) return $id;
 $account=get_userdata($id);
 return $account && in_array('administrator',$account->roles,true) ? 0 : $id;
},PHP_INT_MAX);
